entities.name: H. S. Wong
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: H. S. "Newsreel" Wong was a Chinese newsreel photojournalist. He is most notable for Bloody Saturday, a photograph of a crying baby in Shanghai that he took during the Second Sino-Japanese War.
